question: We want to compare the means of two populations that follow normal distributions and have the same variance. We take two samples of size n1 and n2. When constructing a confidence interval we will have to calculate a value t for a Student's T distribution with:

options.ope: Degrees of freedom calculated with the formula of Welch or Smith-Satterwhite.

analysis: When comparing the means of two populations with normal distributions and equal variances, the value of t for a Student's T distribution is calculated using the formula (n1 + n2 - 2) degrees of freedom.
